asr.full_text: So we had the Cardano Foundation CEOs speak out today about the price of the native token ADA. And I thought it was really interesting. And I haven't made a Cardano video in a while. And I figured, you know what, this is kind of the time to do it. We're finally getting some insight from somebody who matters that can actually talk about this. And so let me just preface the whole conversation by saying this, you know, Cardano was one of the first assets I got into back in 2020, when I first got into crypto. And it was one of the first blue chips at the time. Top ten cryptocurrencies that I got into after kind of finding my way through the stock market, dogecoin I got on Robinhood. And then it was essentially Cardano, Shiba Inu, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and the list goes on, right? But there's no way to sugarcoat it. Cardano's price action has been miserable. I mean, we're back down to lower ranges that we were in in 2023. Now, on one hand, you could say, hey, you know what? It's been passed up by Solana. but you can see that it ended up trading for $4,023. Now, on one hand, you could say, hey, you know what? It's been passed up by Solana. Then you had New Kit on the block, this most recent cycle with SWE. You know, that stole some of the thunder. But there's also another side of the coin, right? Another side of the coin is, it is holding some strong support and that we're talking about levels that we haven't seen since late 2022 all the way into late 2023. we're at that lower range you guys can see my chart and i'm showing you guys here on the monthly we're literally right back down there now when i'm looking at this chart if it holds here at this level i mean it looks really good i mean and so you know we're talking about a 10X from here just to get back to all-time highs. And again, it's hard because it hasn't made a big significant move in a long time. You got to go back to November, 2024, which is when Trump got elected. He mentioned that Cardano would be in a strategic reserve and it literally shot up. I remember where I was at. I was at a coffee shop on a Saturday morning and Cardano, XRP and Solana all skyrocketed that day. And I was trading the hell out of those assets that day. But since then, I mean, it has been downhill and you've had some other, you know, interesting layer ones obviously come out. Solana, okay. Ethereum's been there. So I'm not here to say Cardano can't make a resurgence uh but let's get into what was said today about the foundation um CEO from the foundation what he had to say so he actually joined uh X Spaces I don't know which space he was on but um he had some optimistic predictions about A's future. And he said a few different things. He talked a little bit about Pentad. So one of the big highlights of the broadcast was Frederick Gergard is his name. Him sharing some information about the Cardano Foundation's recent work, emphasizing the foundation's alignment with In output global which is iog and he says we are taking pentad to a whole new level many teams with different roles visions and opportunities are working closely together there is complete alignment between iog and the foundation regarding the pace of the 70 million ADA distribution. Garrigard spoke about the integration of the Inter-Blockchain Communication Protocol or IBC into Cardano's ecosystem. And he said, there's a possibility of paying with ADA in some supermarkets in Switzerland. This has been discussed. One participant asked, what are the fees when paying with ADA and swiss supermarkets are there any regard stated that ada payments have been activated in 137 stores already in collaboration with open crypto pay and swiss fintech company you trust so when i read this it's like okay that's awesome but is it going to help the price not necessarily right like and i think this is the big question with a lot of altcoins right now you know we've got the clarity act supposedly on the table you know people are saying that it should be done by the end of april of course the big banks are fighting the big crypto companies like coinbase and ripple because well quite frankly they're scared of what's coming with stablecoins. But if we get that passed, I think the next big question is, how are these tokens going to fit into the new law, the new finance system? Because essentially, we're integrating something new into an old system. So like, are these going to be securities are we going to ensure that these tokens are tied to the company therefore it'd be like investing in a stock like who's gonna who's gonna overlook these things is it gonna be the cftc it will be if they're commodities is it gonna be the sec is it gonna be both are they gonna be like a hybrid security commodity and the big thing that comes out of this is use case and i think as time goes on here i'm trying to really position myself where if i'm investing in all coins and this is something i've learned in real time guys like and you guys know how i've operated on my channel like i change my mind a lot and if you listen all the time you'll kind of see where i'm going and what i'm thinking you have to in a space that changes as much as blockchain and crypto and i've got to this point where i'm like i only want to put my money into assets now that are actually going to be generating revenue and so when i think of cardano you know it's super secure and the thing i've always been hung up on is the idea of like, you know, voting systems. I mean, you know, it would be awesome to get the entire United States voting system on blockchain. Right. And it's going to take a blockchain that's super secure. It doesn't really need to be scalable per se like an Ethereum, but it has to be really secure like a Cardano. So I had this conversation the other day on somebody else's space and somebody asked me about you know the layer one scene and all coins and i said just that i mean you're gonna have to find a particular use case once all of this clarity gets done because we have a lot of stuff out there and quite frankly like we don't need all of these things out there i think the the market is a little watered down um but cardano survived this long right it's been around since 2017. so it has some things going for it we talked about price action it's you know on these low low levels that we haven't seen since late 2022 which is insane i mean it's at the depths of the bear market in 2022 i will say this if cardona's price breaks down past 24 cents it does not look good so I mean you want to see this line held here at 27 cents but if we start to see a reversal from here and we start to see some strength it could be an interesting opportunity it could be a really interesting opportunity and we can look at a lot of altcoins and paint a similar picture and that's what I I'm gonna be looking for, and obviously, news and information. So I mean, am I happy to hear from Cardano Foundation CEO? Yeah, but he didn't really tell me anything, like I want to know what's actually going on. When I'm looking at things like a hyperliquid right now which I recently invested a good amount into aster like these perp deck says they have a business bottle, it's a clear revenue model that um makes sense now the question with these is regulation so it's like essentially what i'm saying is it's hard to get into all coins right now with size because we have so many things on the table and a lot of uncertainty right but if i'm looking at cardano it's still in the top 10 it's been there since 2017 it's went through some ups it's went through some downs but it has survived it's clinging to the top 10 i will say that hyper liquids on its heels so is bitcoin cash and leo but it's still here and it's going to be interesting to watch how it all plays out and unfolds. And we'll be here every step of the way. So I appreciate y'all for watching. Make sure you guys definitely subscribe and do be a solid. Put the notification bell on. A lot of people, even when they subscribe, my videos still don't pop up for whatever reason. It's a little different when we're in a crypto bull run. But put notifications on so you don't miss out. Check out my free crypto newsletter. There's a link to that down below i think i'm partnered up with like five different crypto exchanges now all great offers if you want to come trade with us and if you want to see all the moves i'm making which i'm doing a lot right now in the stock market especially check our patreon out uh patreon out there's a link down below to that
